name: delete-person
description: Permanently delete a person by their unique identifier (ID). The ID must be a non-empty string representing a valid person identifier. This operation is irreversible and will permanently remove the person record. Returns a success confirmation message if the deletion is successful. Returns an error if the person is not found, has dependencies, or if access is denied. People with existing dependencies (e.g., linked entities) cannot be deleted. Requires authentication with a valid JWT token.

id.description: Unique identifier of the person to delete (required, non-empty string)

text.description: JSON string containing success status and confirmation message
